name: Dolphin Spotter Ewan

intro.text: An hour after low tide, that's when they come. You're blocking my view of the water, so we'll have to sort this out quickly.

win: Och, I missed a breach watching you. Worth it. Nearly.
after: The Moray Firth dolphins are the most northerly bottlenose dolphins in the world, and some of the biggest. They need all that blubber. Have you felt this water?
